arStrings.szText:
{icon:AttributeBullet, 0.5}  Monsters will never leash
{icon:AttributeBullet, 0.5}  Elites, Champions and Goblins drop Orbs
{icon:AttributeBullet, 0.5}  Monsters grant progress proportional to their XP
{icon:AttributeBullet, 0.5}  Orbs and Minor Orbs grant bonus progress
{icon:AttributeBullet, 0.5}  Reviving at a checkpoint has an escalating time penalty
{icon:AttributeBullet, 0.5}  Structures can be destroyed to spawn a random Pylon
